A man discovers that his seemingly perfect life is a lie when he stumbles upon evidence that suggests his wife may be involved in a dangerous underground plot.

A small-town police officer investigates a series of mysterious disappearances, only to discover that they are connected to a dangerous underground network.

A man receives a strange package that leads him down a path of deception, where he must figure out who is behind the elaborate conspiracy before it’s too late.
A detective investigating a string of murders discovers a chilling connection between the victims that leads to a shocking revelation about the killer’s identity.

A bounty hunter chases down a notorious criminal across the barren desert, but as the pursuit wears on, the lines between justice and revenge begin to blur.
A young sheriff must stand his ground against an infamous outlaw and his gang who threaten to take over the town, testing the young man’s courage and morality.
A rancher seeks revenge against those who murdered his family, but his journey into the wilderness puts him face-to-face with old enemies and dangerous allies.

A lawman is forced into a final showdown with a notorious gang leader who has terrorized the town for years, and only one can walk away alive.
A former outlaw turned preacher must confront his violent past when his old gang returns to terrorize the town he’s vowed to protect.
An aging gunslinger, past his prime, must mentor a young protege in the ways of the West, even as his own skills and reputation are challenged.
A wagon train heading westward is ambushed by Native American tribes, and the survivors must navigate hostile terrain and escalating tensions to survive.
A small town in the Wild West is torn apart by the arrival of a ruthless land baron who aims to take control of the region by force, and the townspeople must fight back.
A former outlaw’s quest for redemption is tested when he’s forced to choose between his old criminal ways and his newfound moral compass in the face of a deadly threat.

A cowboy, fresh from a gold rush town, must face his past when a former love interest resurfaces, and old betrayals threaten his new life and freedom.
A lone vigilante rides into a town that has been oppressed by a cruel sheriff, and must use his wits and strength to liberate the people from tyranny.
When a train carrying a fortune in gold is hijacked by outlaws, a group of former army soldiers must band together to reclaim it in a race against time.

descriptions: A behind-the-scenes look at the lives of professional athletes, exposing the pressures and sacrifices they make for fame and success.
Explores the global impact of climate change through the personal stories of people around the world who are fighting to protect the planet.
Follows the journey of a group of explorers as they navigate uncharted waters, documenting their discoveries and challenges along the way.
A deep dive into the life and work of a legendary artist, offering a rare glimpse into the creative process behind some of the most iconic pieces in history.
Examines the rise of social media influencers and their influence on youth culture, exploring the fine line between authenticity and performance in the digital age.
A critical look at the history of space exploration, highlighting both the triumphs and tragedies of mankind’s journey into the cosmos.
Documents the harrowing journey of refugees fleeing war-torn countries and the struggles they face in finding a new life in foreign lands.
A deep investigation into the world's most famous unsolved crimes, offering new theories and insights into these mysterious cases.
Takes a closer look at the impact of modern technology on education, focusing on how digital tools are shaping the future of learning worldwide.

A look at the world of competitive gaming, examining the lives of professional e-sports players and the culture surrounding this booming industry.

Explores the beauty and complexities of indigenous cultures, capturing their history, traditions, and efforts to preserve their way of life in a rapidly changing world.
A powerful documentary on the global crisis of food insecurity, looking at both the root causes and innovative solutions to address hunger worldwide.
A portrait of a political movement that sparked change, examining the leaders, struggles, and triumphs that shaped the fight for justice and freedom.
Follows a group of innovators as they work to develop groundbreaking technology in medicine, offering an inside look at how science is changing healthcare.
An investigative documentary that exposes the dark side of the fashion industry, highlighting exploitation and the environmental impact of fast fashion.
A heartfelt exploration of the human connection to animals, highlighting stories of individuals who dedicate their lives to rescuing and rehabilitating endangered species.

genres.name: Musical
descriptions: A young woman dreams of becoming a Broadway star, but must overcome personal struggles and fierce competition to achieve her lifelong goal.
Set in a small town, a group of high school students puts together an elaborate musical production, learning life lessons along the way.
A rock musician struggles with the pressures of fame, but finds redemption through an unexpected collaboration with an up-and-coming singer.
In a magical world where music has the power to shape reality, a young hero embarks on a quest to use their voice to save their kingdom from a dark force.
A washed-up actor is given one last chance to revive his career by starring in a lavish stage musical, leading him to confront both his past and his future.
Two rival performing arts schools compete for the top prize in a prestigious competition, where friendships are tested and dreams are realized on stage.
A young girl from a small town is swept up in the glittering world of Broadway, where she must navigate romance, rivalries, and the struggles of making it in show business.
Set against the backdrop of a 1960s jukebox musical, a group of friends finds their lives intertwined with classic pop songs as they chase their dreams and navigate love.
A group of workers in a steel mill dreams of escaping their grueling lives through the power of music, coming together to form a rock band that changes their futures.
A talented but introverted high school student gets the opportunity of a lifetime to star in the school’s musical, but must face their stage fright and self-doubt first.
A musical about the love and rivalry between two dancers in a world-renowned ballet company, where passion and artistry collide in dramatic and spectacular ways.

A young composer battling writer's block embarks on a soul-searching adventure to discover new inspiration, accompanied by a whimsical group of friends who sing their way through life.
Set in a futuristic city, a group of rebels fights for freedom by starting an underground musical movement, using the power of song to inspire others to join their cause.
In a musical journey through time, a young woman discovers her family’s hidden past, finding clues and songs that unlock long-forgotten secrets from generations before her.
A love-struck couple at a summer camp must put on a spectacular musical performance to win a competition, navigating obstacles, rivalries, and the pressures of their budding relationship.
A washed-up rock star returns to his hometown to teach music to a group of misfit students, only to discover they have the potential to create the greatest musical ensemble he’s ever seen.
A girl with big dreams and a passion for singing is given the chance of a lifetime to audition for a role in a Broadway show, but her journey will test her patience and perseverance.
Set in the world of competitive dance, a gifted dancer and a talented musician form an unlikely partnership to create a musical that will leave the world in awe.
A group of misfit kids form an unlikely musical troupe, competing in an international competition where they learn the power of self-expression and the magic of music.
Set in 1920s Paris, an aspiring actress and a composer meet under mysterious circumstances, their love story unfolding through dazzling musical numbers and dramatic twists.

genres.name: Family
descriptions: A young boy and his talking dog embark on a series of hilarious adventures to save their town from an impending disaster.
A family of misfit superheroes must come together to defeat an evil villain threatening to destroy the world, learning to appreciate each other's unique talents.
A young girl discovers that her new neighbors are actually time travelers, and together they must stop an evil force from altering history.
A brother and sister find a magical book that transports them to a fantasy world where they must work together to solve riddles and defeat a powerful sorcerer.
A lonely child befriends a mysterious creature from another world, and together they embark on an adventure to save both their homes from an ancient evil.
A group of unlikely animal friends form a club to protect their forest from a greedy developer, using their wits and courage to save their home.
When their parents are away, a group of kids must work together to foil the plans of a mischievous villain who is plotting to ruin their summer vacation.
A young orphan discovers that she is the heir to a magical kingdom, and must face her fears and embrace her destiny to save her family and friends.
A family of ordinary humans moves into a house full of strange and quirky creatures, and together they must overcome the challenges of living with such eccentric neighbors.

A group of children with extraordinary abilities must learn to work together to stop an evil mastermind from stealing their powers and using them for his own gain.
A young girl befriends a magical horse that can fly, and together they embark on an incredible journey to find a lost city and uncover the truth behind a legendary treasure.
A family road trip turns into an unexpected adventure when they are pursued by a group of mysterious creatures, and must rely on each other to survive.
A shy boy who’s afraid of public speaking is chosen to give a speech at his school’s talent show, and with the help of his friends, he overcomes his fear and finds his voice.
A group of kids discovers a hidden door in their school that leads to a magical realm, where they must stop a powerful sorcerer from taking over both worlds.
A young girl and her brother are sent on an unexpected adventure to find their missing parents, uncovering a web of secrets and hidden mysteries along the way.
A talented young gymnast overcomes self-doubt and fear to make her dream of competing in the national championships a reality, with the support of her loving family.
A lonely robot becomes the unlikely hero of a futuristic city, and with the help of a group of resourceful kids, they work together to protect their home from a powerful corporation.
A group of young explorers sets out on a journey to discover a hidden treasure buried deep in a remote jungle, but they must outsmart dangerous traps and rival treasure hunters.
A little girl’s vivid imagination brings her drawings to life, and she must use her creativity to save her town from a group of mischievous creatures she accidentally created.

genres.name: Sport
descriptions: A talented young athlete with dreams of becoming a professional football player must overcome obstacles both on and off the field to prove she has what it takes.
A struggling boxer is given one last chance to fight for the title, but he must overcome personal demons and fierce competition to achieve his ultimate goal.
A washed-up baseball player finds new hope when he’s given the chance to coach a struggling minor league team, leading them to an improbable victory.
A young tennis prodigy faces fierce competition at the national championships, but her true battle is against her own self-doubt and the pressure to succeed.
A former Olympic champion trains for a comeback after years of personal and professional setbacks, with the support of his dedicated coach and family.
A small-town basketball team with no hope of winning the state championship comes together under the leadership of a passionate coach to defy expectations.
A high school runner must overcome physical limitations and a troubled home life to make it to the state finals, with the help of his teammates and coach.
A former football star whose career ended in scandal fights to redeem himself by coaching a struggling team and teaching them life lessons along the way.
A talented figure skater must put aside her rivalry with a fellow skater and work together to secure a spot on the Olympic team in a thrilling and emotional competition.
A young swimmer with a troubled past seeks redemption by training for a national competition, finding strength in his team and his own determination.
A rugby player from a small town dreams of playing professionally, but must overcome injuries, financial struggles, and a lack of support to make it to the big leagues.
A gymnast struggling with the pressure of competition forms an unexpected bond with a former champion, who helps her rediscover her love for the sport.
A high school baseball player must decide whether to pursue his dream of going pro or stay loyal to his team and friends during a pivotal championship game.
A seasoned marathon runner faces one last challenge: to compete in the most grueling race of his career, pushing both his body and mind to the limit.
A young skateboarder dreams of competing in the X Games, but must overcome personal and external obstacles to prove he has what it takes to make it to the top.
A legendary hockey coach comes out of retirement to train a ragtag team of underdogs for the state championship, teaching them the importance of teamwork and perseverance.
A female boxer must prove herself in a male-dominated sport, facing fierce opponents and overcoming sexism to become a world champion.
A young track star trains tirelessly for the Olympics, facing both physical and mental challenges on her path to the gold medal.
A group of misfit athletes comes together to compete in a local tournament, discovering the true meaning of teamwork and friendship along the way.
A veteran race car driver takes a young rookie under his wing, teaching him the art of racing and the importance of never giving up on your dreams.

genres.name: War
descriptions: A young soldier, thrust into the horrors of battle, must navigate the chaos of war while questioning the morality of the conflict he's involved in.
Set during World War II, a group of soldiers is tasked with a dangerous mission behind enemy lines, where they must survive while confronting their own fears and camaraderie.
A veteran of the Vietnam War returns home to find his life in shambles and must confront his past to heal and find redemption.
During a brutal siege, a team of elite soldiers must defend a key military outpost, facing overwhelming odds and an enemy determined to break their resolve.
In the aftermath of a devastating war, two soldiers from opposing sides must form an unlikely alliance to survive and escape a conflict-ridden landscape.
A sniper in the Iraq War must deal with the emotional toll of taking lives from a distance, while being haunted by the lives he's changed forever.
In a dystopian future, a group of soldiers fights to reclaim their homeland from an oppressive government, using guerrilla tactics to wage war against an increasingly powerful enemy.
A young recruit to a mercenary group must navigate the brutal realities of war while grappling with the moral implications of the violence he's committing for money.
A ragtag group of civilians must take up arms to defend their city when enemy forces launch an unexpected attack, and the line between soldier and civilian blurs.
A determined general leads his troops into the most perilous battle of the war, knowing the cost will be high but that victory is the only option for survival.
Two enemies caught in the crossfire of an ancient conflict must work together to escape the battlefield, learning about each other's humanity in the process.

In the aftermath of World War I, a group of soldiers returns home only to face the trauma and scars of their experiences, struggling to reintegrate into civilian life.
A small group of elite commandos is dispatched on a mission to infiltrate enemy territory, only to find themselves facing overwhelming opposition and making desperate decisions.
A soldier must overcome the horrors of war and the loss of his comrades as he leads his troops into a final, decisive battle that will determine the fate of the nation.
Set against the backdrop of the Cold War, two opposing soldiers find themselves stuck in a battle of wills as they are forced to work together to survive a failed mission.
During the height of World War II, a fighter pilot faces the harsh realities of combat, struggling with the physical and emotional toll of aerial warfare.
A soldier stranded in the jungles of Southeast Asia during the Vietnam War must rely on his survival skills to navigate the treacherous terrain and evade enemy forces.
A battlefield medic on the front lines must make impossible decisions about who to save and who to leave behind, all while grappling with the trauma of war.
In a war-torn country, a group of civilians must escape the fighting and flee to safety, but as the violence intensifies, they must make difficult choices about who they can trust.

genres.name: Crime Thriller
descriptions: A detective investigates a series of seemingly unrelated crimes, only to discover they are connected by a criminal mastermind with a personal vendetta.
A young woman goes undercover to infiltrate a dangerous criminal organization, but as she gets closer to her target, she becomes entangled in a deadly web of lies and betrayal.
A skilled thief is caught in the act during a high-stakes heist and must work with a relentless investigator to uncover the mastermind behind a series of escalating crimes.
A former criminal turned informant is forced to testify against his former associates, putting his life at risk as he becomes the target of vengeful gang members.
A detective with a dark past is called in to investigate a string of high-profile murders, only to discover the killer’s motives are tied to a personal tragedy from his own life.
In a gritty urban city, a group of criminals pulls off a meticulously planned heist, but things quickly spiral out of control as trust breaks down and the law closes in.
A former hitman is pulled back into a life of crime when his family is kidnapped by a criminal cartel, forcing him to confront his violent past in a race against time.
A small-time crook becomes embroiled in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with law enforcement after accidentally stumbling upon evidence of a much larger conspiracy.
An honest police officer must work with a ruthless criminal to solve a case involving a series of brutal crimes, leading to an unexpected partnership that blurs the lines of justice.
A retired detective is called back into action when a cold case is reopened, forcing him to confront painful memories and secrets that have haunted him for years.

A seasoned private investigator is hired to track down a missing person, but the case takes a dark turn as he uncovers a complex web of crime, corruption, and betrayal.
A mob boss must navigate a shifting underworld, where betrayal lurks around every corner and a long-time associate is plotting to take over his empire.
An innocent man is framed for a high-profile murder and must rely on his wit and resourcefulness to clear his name while evading a relentless pursuit by both the police and the real killer.

A street-smart hustler gets in over his head when he unknowingly crosses paths with a dangerous crime syndicate, forcing him to use every trick in the book to survive.
A young detective must solve a series of grisly murders before the killer strikes again, but as the investigation deepens, the case reveals unexpected personal ties to her own past.
A woman searching for her missing brother uncovers a conspiracy involving a powerful crime syndicate, forcing her to confront her own moral compass and make impossible choices.
A former criminal is given a second chance at life, but when his old associates come calling, he must risk everything to protect his new life and the family he’s built.

genres.name: Psychological Thriller
descriptions: A brilliant psychiatrist becomes obsessed with uncovering the truth behind a patient’s mysterious symptoms, only to find himself drawn into a dangerous game of manipulation.
A woman suffering from amnesia tries to piece together her past, but the more she uncovers, the more she doubts her own sanity as a dark conspiracy unravels.
A seemingly ordinary man begins to experience unsettling visions of a life he doesn’t remember, leading him to question whether he’s losing his mind or being targeted by a shadowy figure.
A young detective investigating a series of bizarre disappearances starts to question his own perception of reality as he uncovers disturbing truths about his own past.
A successful lawyer begins to unravel when a mysterious stranger starts to taunt him with cryptic messages, slowly revealing the dark secrets he’s tried to bury.
A woman in a seemingly perfect marriage starts to notice strange inconsistencies in her husband’s behavior, leading her to suspect that he may not be who he claims to be.
A brilliant writer trapped in a remote cabin begins to lose his grip on reality as the line between his fiction and the outside world blurs in terrifying ways.
A couple’s life is turned upside down when their young daughter begins exhibiting strange, dangerous behavior, leading them to question whether something supernatural is at play.
A man who has spent years in solitary confinement begins to experience hallucinations, unsure if they are a result of his isolation or part of a deeper conspiracy.
A therapist treating a patient with multiple personalities becomes increasingly obsessed with discovering the truth, only to find herself drawn into a dangerous psychological battle.

A successful businessman begins to experience strange occurrences and unsettling dreams, leading him to suspect that someone is manipulating his reality for sinister purposes.

A woman’s life is turned upside down when she starts receiving cryptic letters from an unknown person claiming to know the truth about her family’s dark past.
A man wakes up in a hotel room with no memory of how he got there, and as he searches for answers, he becomes entangled in a psychological nightmare that threatens his life.
A detective investigating a string of seemingly unrelated deaths starts to uncover clues that suggest the victims’ minds were manipulated before their demise, leading to an unsettling conclusion.
A man receives mysterious messages claiming to be from his future self, warning him of impending dangers, but as he tries to act on the warnings, he begins to lose touch with reality.
A woman with dissociative identity disorder begins to uncover the truth about her past, but as her personalities fight for control, she realizes the danger lies in her fractured mind.

genres.name: Superhero
descriptions: A young, ordinary man discovers he has superhuman abilities and must balance his new powers with his everyday life while learning the responsibility that comes with them.
A former vigilante, now retired, is pulled back into action when a new, dangerous villain emerges, threatening the world he’s tried to leave behind.
A team of heroes with unique powers must come together to stop a world-destroying force, facing challenges of trust, loyalty, and the burden of their powers.
A superhero who has long been in hiding must step out of the shadows to save the city, only to face opposition from former allies who question his motivations.
After a freak accident gives her incredible strength, a young woman must learn to control her powers while protecting her loved ones from dangerous forces bent on exploiting her abilities.
A superhero struggles with the duality of their life as a hero and a regular citizen, torn between saving the world and keeping their identity hidden from those they love.
A brilliant scientist is transformed into a powerful being with extraordinary abilities, but struggles to maintain control of his mind and powers as he faces a personal crisis.
A group of misfit heroes with no formal training must band together to defeat a powerful villain, learning what it means to be true heroes along the way.

A hero who lost everything in a tragic event seeks revenge against those responsible, but the deeper he gets into his quest, the more he risks losing his own humanity.

A woman with the power of super intelligence must stop a villainous mastermind who has created an army of super-powered drones, but in doing so, she risks losing her own mind.
An everyday person gains extraordinary strength and abilities, and as they fight to protect their neighborhood, they learn what it truly means to be a hero in a world full of villains.

genres.name: Gothic
descriptions: A young woman moves into a decaying mansion with her husband, only to uncover dark secrets about the house's past that lead her to question her own sanity.

A tortured artist begins to lose his grip on reality as he becomes increasingly obsessed with a mysterious, spectral woman he sees in his paintings, convinced that she is trying to communicate with him from beyond the grave.

A man returns to his ancestral home to reclaim his inheritance, only to find that his family’s dark legacy is intertwined with the supernatural, and he must unravel a centuries-old mystery to survive.

In a Gothic manor perched on a cliff, a family is haunted by disturbing visions of a long-dead ancestor, and as they delve deeper into the mystery, they realize the ghost’s thirst for vengeance has never been quenched.

A woman moves into a decaying estate in the countryside, where she is haunted by strange dreams and encounters with mysterious figures, leading her to uncover a deadly curse that has plagued her bloodline for centuries.

A woman’s investigation into a local legend of a tragic love affair leads her to uncover dark family secrets, spirits of the past, and a supernatural mystery that consumes her every waking moment.

In a secluded mansion surrounded by fog, a young man discovers that his family’s estate holds the key to unlocking the mysteries of his past, and he must confront the ghosts of his ancestors to secure his future.

A woman returns to her childhood home, a sprawling manor on the edge of a dark forest, where she begins to experience strange phenomena tied to the house’s tragic history and a family curse that may still be at work.

genres.name: Zombie
descriptions: A small town is thrown into chaos when a mysterious virus spreads, turning the population into ravenous zombies. A group of survivors must fight for their lives while seeking refuge from the undead onslaught.

In the midst of a zombie outbreak, a group of strangers finds themselves trapped in an isolated shopping mall, where they must put aside their differences and work together to escape before it's too late.
