A soldier in the midst of a zombie outbreak is forced to protect a group of civilians while battling his own doubts and fears about what’s left of humanity in a world of the undead.
After a virus turns the population into zombies, a group of survivors takes refuge in a remote farmhouse, but their sanctuary becomes increasingly unsafe as the undead close in on all sides.
A scientist working on a vaccine for the zombie virus is forced to make a choice between a cure and survival when she becomes one of the infected, slowly losing her own humanity.

A small group of survivors embarks on a desperate journey to find safety, but as they trek through a post-apocalyptic landscape, they are forced to confront their inner demons and the horrors of the undead.
A former zombie hunter, now living in isolation, is forced to rejoin the fight when a new wave of zombies threatens to overrun what little remains of civilization.
In a world where the undead roam freely, a man must protect his family while struggling with his own transformation into a zombie, trying to find a way to save them before it’s too late.
A group of survivors in a zombie-infested city must make a choice between staying put and holding onto hope or venturing into unknown territory in search of a rumored safe zone.

In a post-apocalyptic world, a man wakes up to find his entire town has been turned into zombies, and he must struggle to survive in a landscape filled with the undead and the living who are just as dangerous.
A zombie outbreak threatens to destroy an entire city, and a group of survivors must fight their way through the chaos, facing both the undead and other humans who will stop at nothing to survive.
A family trapped in a house during a zombie outbreak must face the horrors outside and the secrets within, as they try to survive long enough to escape the looming undead horde.
After a zombie apocalypse ravages the earth, a young girl becomes the last hope for humanity when she shows signs of immunity to the virus that turns people into zombies.
In a world where zombies have taken over, a group of survivors discovers a hidden sanctuary, but the sanctuary comes with a dark secret that threatens to unravel their fragile peace.
A detective investigates a series of mysterious disappearances that seem to coincide with a rising number of zombie attacks, leading him to uncover a chilling conspiracy.
A small band of survivors discovers a potential cure for the zombie virus but must battle their way through an infected city to get it to safety before it's lost forever.

genres.name: Romantic Comedy
descriptions: A quirky bookshop owner unexpectedly falls for the charming but arrogant customer who’s been regularly criticizing her taste in books, leading to a series of humorous and heartwarming misadventures.
A wedding planner is tasked with organizing the wedding of her ex-fiancé, but sparks fly again when they reunite and realize that old feelings are not so easily forgotten.
Two rival food critics are forced to team up for a prestigious culinary event, only to find that the competition between them is nothing compared to the chemistry they share.
A woman desperate to prove her independence pretends to be in a relationship with her best friend, but as they continue to fake it, their feelings for each other begin to blur the lines of reality.
A young woman moves to a new city for a fresh start and unwittingly falls in love with her neighbor, who just happens to be the most eligible bachelor in town – but he’s already engaged.

A socially awkward man agrees to a blind date arranged by his overbearing mother, but he ends up falling for the woman who has no idea that they were set up, leading to a series of comedic misunderstandings.
A career-driven woman has her world turned upside down when she’s forced to work closely with a free-spirited, laid-back man who challenges everything she believes about love and happiness.
Two childhood friends reunite years after a falling out, only to discover they both still harbor feelings for each other, but now they must navigate their complicated past and new relationships.

A quirky scientist is forced to team up with a charming but clumsy man to solve a mystery that could change the course of history, all while discovering that love has a funny way of surprising them both.

A wedding photographer known for capturing perfect moments falls for a groom who’s clearly not in love with his bride, leading to hilarious yet heartfelt situations as they try to navigate the messy world of weddings and relationships.

A woman who has spent years dodging commitment suddenly finds herself falling for a man who has just moved into her apartment building, and they both struggle to keep their budding romance under wraps.

A couple who met through a chance encounter at a coffee shop decides to test the concept of ‘love at first sight’ by going on a series of spontaneous, unconventional dates that leave them questioning whether they’re truly meant to be together.

A man who has always avoided relationships falls for a woman who believes in soulmates, but as their relationship progresses, he struggles to understand the idea of true love while trying to prove to her that love isn’t as simple as fate.

A small-town baker is thrown into the spotlight when a famous food critic visits her shop, but she’s more interested in the handsome journalist who’s covering the event than the fame or fortune that comes with the review.
Two unlikely roommates, a hopeless romantic and a cynical divorcee, find themselves trying to outsmart each other’s love life advice, but soon realize that they have more in common than they thought.
A woman who swears off men after a series of bad relationships ends up falling for her best friend’s brother, but she’s not sure if it’s love or just a case of 'too close to home' confusion.

A man who’s just been dumped by his girlfriend finds himself in a race against time to win her back, but along the way, he meets a charming woman who might just change his perspective on what he really wants.

A woman’s life is turned upside down when her childhood crush suddenly reappears in her life, and she must navigate the awkwardness of their reunion while managing her current relationship and figuring out her true feelings.

An uptight lawyer is forced to work with a carefree artist on a community project, and their contrasting personalities lead to humorous situations, all while sparks fly between them in the most unexpected of ways.

A couple who have been in a long-distance relationship for years finally get the chance to live in the same city, but they quickly discover that love looks very different in reality than it did on screen.

A cynical wedding guest who has given up on love unexpectedly finds herself falling for the best man at a wedding, and despite her reluctance, she can’t seem to stay away from him as their playful banter turns into something more.

genres.name: Satire
descriptions: A small-town mayor, caught in a web of political corruption and media manipulation, embarks on a chaotic journey to expose the truth, only to discover that the lines between reality and satire have blurred.

A group of misfit employees at a failing tech company plot to overthrow their clueless CEO, only to realize they’ve inadvertently become part of a bizarre corporate experiment designed to mock the modern workplace.

In a world where social media influencers hold the most power, a group of rebellious youths creates a parody account that spirals out of control, turning them into accidental heroes of a new anti-establishment movement.

A wealthy celebrity launches a reality show that mocks the lives of the average citizen, but when the show becomes too successful, they find themselves caught in a never-ending cycle of public humiliation and self-reflection.

A group of struggling artists begins to satire the art world itself by creating absurd works designed to mock the pretentious nature of the industry, but their work becomes so popular they’re forced to question their true motivations.

A naive politician, eager to change the world, becomes the subject of a viral campaign mocking his every move, leading him to question the nature of power and influence in a society obsessed with spectacle.

A satire of the fashion industry where a washed-up designer is forced to work with a group of avant-garde artists who create absurd and nonsensical designs, making fun of the world’s obsession with beauty and appearance.

In a world where politicians are nothing more than puppets controlled by corporate sponsors, a group of activists creates a parody campaign to expose the absurdity of modern democracy, only to find themselves more powerful than they ever intended.

A disgruntled journalist goes undercover as a reality TV star in an attempt to expose the shallowness of modern entertainment, but he ends up becoming the star of his own show in a satirical twist of fate.

A group of eccentric, self-absorbed billionaires start a company that claims to solve all of society’s problems, but their efforts quickly become a satire of their own greed, incompetence, and lack of self-awareness.

A celebrity chef opens a new restaurant that becomes the latest culinary craze, but as the restaurant grows in popularity, it transforms into a satirical commentary on the commercialization of food culture.

A late-night talk show host, sick of the absurdities in the world, decides to take a no-holds-barred approach to his show, poking fun at the celebrity culture, politics, and society’s obsession with scandal.

A once-popular tech mogul, now retired, embarks on a journey to ‘reinvent’ himself by creating a satirical startup that mocks Silicon Valley’s obsession with innovation, but the startup’s success threatens to turn his parody into a real business.

A schoolteacher tries to create a curriculum that challenges societal norms and forces students to think critically, but his methods lead to hilarious and absurd consequences as both students and parents react unpredictably.

A failed actor writes a memoir that humorously satirizes the cutthroat world of Hollywood, but when the book becomes a bestseller, he’s forced to deal with the unexpected consequences of exposing the dark side of fame.

A group of high school students, tired of the pressures of modern education, band together to create a mock campaign to 'reform' their school, poking fun at the ridiculousness of academic bureaucracy.
A family tries to live an ordinary life in a world that’s become a reality TV show, satirizing the commercialization of personal lives and the absurdity of constantly being under public scrutiny.

A politically incorrect comedian decides to tackle the current state of the media by creating a viral show that mocks everything from reality TV to sensationalized news, leading to a series of controversial and hilarious public reactions.

A satirical look at the world of corporate team-building retreats, where a group of employees is forced to attend an absurd and comically disastrous event that turns into a metaphor for modern office culture.

A group of revolutionaries attempts to overthrow a corrupt government but soon realizes that their movement is being hijacked by media influencers and corporate interests, turning their rebellion into a satirical spectacle.

genres.name: Political Drama
descriptions: A young idealistic politician rises through the ranks of the government, only to find himself torn between his own morals and the political machinery that threatens to consume him.
In a nation on the brink of war, a seasoned diplomat struggles to prevent a conflict between world powers while grappling with personal relationships and ethical compromises.
A controversial campaign manager is brought in to run a candidate’s struggling political race, but as the stakes grow higher, they must navigate scandals, backroom deals, and betrayals.
A seasoned senator fights to pass crucial legislation, but as opposition from political rivals intensifies, she must confront her own past and the personal sacrifices made along the way.
When a political leader is accused of corruption, a team of investigative journalists races against time to uncover the truth, leading to a high-stakes battle between power and justice.
After a devastating election loss, a once-powerful politician grapples with life in the public eye, working behind the scenes to mount a comeback while questioning the price of power.
A highly ambitious governor uses every tool at his disposal to ensure his re-election, but his underhanded tactics and ruthless decisions put his career and the future of his state at risk.

A young activist with revolutionary ideas is thrust into the political spotlight, forcing her to navigate a dangerous game of power, betrayal, and personal sacrifice while trying to stay true to her cause.
A sitting president, facing public outcry over a controversial decision, must rely on his closest advisers to secure his legacy while wrestling with the moral implications of his choices.
As a country grapples with an economic collapse, a determined leader works tirelessly to push through sweeping reforms, but his bold actions alienate both allies and enemies alike.

A whistleblower within the government uncovers a vast conspiracy that threatens national security, but as they seek justice, they must deal with powerful enemies who will stop at nothing to keep the truth hidden.
In the midst of a highly contested election, a former candidate must decide whether to run again and risk reopening old wounds or support his successor and maintain his influence behind the scenes.
A top advisor to a presidential candidate is caught in a moral dilemma after learning of a scandal that could ruin the candidate's career, forcing them to choose between loyalty and honesty.

Amidst a backdrop of economic and social turmoil, a political strategist must navigate public perception, party loyalty, and scandal to lead their candidate to victory in a race that could change the course of history.
A powerful corporate lobbyist faces an internal battle when they are faced with a moral decision that could either save or destroy their career and the future of a nation’s political landscape.
In a politically charged country, a group of young leaders must work together to form a coalition government, but political betrayal and personal ambitions threaten to unravel their fragile alliance.
A campaign manager must defend a presidential candidate accused of unethical behavior while uncovering dark secrets that may expose a conspiracy within the highest ranks of government.
A former military leader turned politician must confront the ghosts of their past as they run for office, but the skeletons that emerge threaten to derail their campaign and their reputation.

A political journalist uncovers a scandal that could topple the government, but the closer they get to the truth, the more they risk becoming a target of powerful forces intent on keeping their secrets hidden.
An idealistic lawmaker fights for reform in a broken political system, but as the pressures mount, they must decide whether to compromise their principles or walk away from the system entirely.

genres.name: Epic
descriptions: Set against the backdrop of an ancient kingdom at war, a fearless general must lead his army to victory while dealing with personal betrayal, love, and the challenges of leadership.
In a world torn apart by conflict, a lone hero rises from humble beginnings to become a legendary figure, fighting to unite fractured nations and restore peace to the land.
A family’s journey across generations forms the heart of this epic saga, as they navigate political upheaval, love, and tragedy in a world that is constantly changing.
A grand tale of exploration and adventure, where a group of explorers braves unknown lands to discover lost civilizations, only to find themselves caught in a battle for survival and power.
A historical epic depicting the rise and fall of a powerful empire, focusing on the ambitious leaders, warriors, and common people who shaped its destiny.
Set in the heart of the medieval world, a young knight sets off on a perilous quest to recover a stolen artifact, facing danger, treachery, and unexpected alliances along the way.
In a time of great revolution, a group of rebels embarks on an epic journey to overthrow an oppressive regime, risking everything for the chance of freedom and a new future.
A story of forbidden love set against the backdrop of war, where two people from opposing sides of a brutal conflict must choose between their loyalties and their hearts.
The tale of a visionary explorer who discovers a new world, leading an expedition to claim the land as their own, only to face unthinkable challenges from the indigenous peoples and natural forces.
An epic battle for power ensues as a young ruler must overcome personal loss, betrayal, and war to secure the throne and protect the future of their kingdom.
A majestic, sweeping saga of a hero’s rise from obscurity to greatness, as they fight to preserve the legacy of an ancient kingdom that is on the brink of collapse.
A gripping epic about the fall of a great civilization, focusing on the lives of its rulers, warriors, and common people as they struggle to survive in a world that is crumbling around them.
Set during the rise of a great empire, a legendary ruler must face internal and external enemies, navigate political intrigue, and make difficult sacrifices to ensure the survival of their legacy.

A sweeping epic about a group of explorers who venture into unknown territories in search of treasure, only to find themselves caught in an epic battle for control of a powerful and mysterious artifact.
A historical epic about the life and reign of a powerful monarch, exploring their triumphs, defeats, and personal struggles as they fight to secure their place in history.
A young warrior embarks on a perilous journey to avenge his fallen family, encountering incredible challenges and forging unbreakable bonds with allies as he faces down a corrupt and brutal empire.
In a time of great peril, a leader must rally an army of misfits to confront a seemingly invincible enemy in a battle that will decide the fate of nations.
A massive war threatens to engulf the known world, and a legendary hero must unite disparate armies and navigate treacherous political alliances to defeat a tyrannical ruler bent on domination.
The story of a legendary hero who must undertake an impossible quest to retrieve a powerful artifact, overcoming treacherous terrain, mythical creatures, and the wrath of an ancient enemy.

In the midst of a tumultuous revolution, a group of individuals must set aside their differences and work together to reshape the future of their nation, risking everything for a chance at freedom and justice.

genres.name: Noir
descriptions: A hard-boiled detective investigates the mysterious disappearance of a high-profile businessman, but soon finds himself entangled in a web of deceit, betrayal, and dangerous liaisons.
In a gritty city filled with corruption, a femme fatale leads a private investigator down a dangerous path where nothing is as it seems, and everyone has a hidden agenda.

A former cop turned private detective is hired by a beautiful woman to investigate her husband’s suspicious activities, only to find himself embroiled in a deadly conspiracy that could cost him everything.
In a post-war city, a down-on-his-luck journalist discovers a secret society pulling the strings behind the scenes, but the deeper he digs, the more his own life spirals into chaos.
A hard-nosed private eye gets entangled in a dangerous love triangle when a wealthy widow hires him to investigate the suspicious death of her husband, leading to deadly consequences.
A disillusioned detective investigates a string of unsolved murders, only to find that the killer’s motives might be tied to his own troubled past and haunting mistakes.
A cynical ex-soldier gets involved in a criminal underworld when he’s hired to track down a missing woman, but his investigation soon uncovers a deadly conspiracy linked to a corrupt politician.
In a city ruled by crime, a morally ambiguous cop must choose between protecting his crooked partner or seeking justice for a murdered woman who had ties to the city's elite.
A washed-up film noir writer is forced to confront his past when a mysterious woman offers him a story that might just be his ticket back to the top, but the plot twists could lead to his undoing.
An experienced detective investigates a series of murders that seem to follow a twisted pattern, only to discover that he may be the next target in a calculated game of cat and mouse.
A nightclub singer with a troubled past becomes the center of a police investigation when a famous mobster is found dead in her apartment, but the truth is more complicated than anyone imagined.
A burnt-out ex-detective agrees to work one last case for a wealthy businessman, but the deeper he digs into the man's secrets, the more he realizes he may have unwittingly walked into a trap.
A disillusioned war vet turned investigator uncovers a shady blackmail scheme while looking into the death of a friend, and soon finds himself in over his head, facing off against ruthless criminals.
In the dark alleyways of a corrupt city, a private eye gets hired by a mysterious client, only to discover that the case is connected to a decades-old unsolved murder and a web of lies.
A failed writer teams up with a grizzled detective to investigate a missing woman case, only to find themselves in a dangerous spiral of deception, betrayal, and murder.
A cynical ex-cop on a personal vendetta discovers a crime syndicate is operating under the nose of the city’s most powerful officials, and his obsession with the case might destroy him.
A disillusioned insurance investigator is called to look into a fraudulent claim, but he soon uncovers a deadly conspiracy involving a stolen diamond, a double-crossing lover, and murder.
A desperate man in a dying marriage gets involved with a mysterious woman and soon finds himself trapped in a web of crime, secrets, and an unrelenting pursuit of vengeance.
A retired detective is pulled back into the seedy underworld when a former case of his resurfaces, but as he revisits the past, he finds himself questioning whether justice was ever served.
A private detective is hired by a millionaire to follow his wife, suspecting infidelity, but as the case unravels, he uncovers a dangerous truth that could cost him his life.

genres.name: Slasher
descriptions: A group of friends on a remote camping trip becomes the target of a masked killer, who picks them off one by one with brutal precision, forcing them to fight for survival.
A masked murderer stalks a small town, targeting high school students on the eve of their graduation, as the townspeople scramble to uncover the killer’s identity before it’s too late.
A serial killer with a twisted agenda begins picking off members of a close-knit community, and it’s up to a group of survivors to uncover the killer’s identity before they become the next victims.
A group of strangers stranded at a rundown motel are picked off by a brutal killer in a series of blood-soaked killings, as they realize they may not all be strangers after all.
A college student returning home for the holidays is stalked by a masked killer with a personal vendetta, leading her to uncover buried secrets from her past that make her a prime target.
A mysterious killer emerges from the woods to stalk a group of teens at a summer camp, but the closer they get to unraveling the killer’s identity, the more gruesome the murders become.
A group of friends who survived a brutal attack years ago find themselves targeted once again by the same masked killer, who has returned to finish what was started.
In the quiet, isolated town of Pinecrest, a series of gruesome murders terrorize the community as a masked figure goes on a killing spree, leaving a trail of bodies in their wake.
A bloodthirsty killer stalks a series of unsuspecting victims in an upscale apartment complex, with each gruesome death revealing more about the killer’s twisted mind and motive.
A troubled teen must confront her past when a deranged killer begins stalking her and her friends, slowly revealing a deep connection between her family’s dark history and the killer’s rage.
A group of teens on a trip to an abandoned amusement park are hunted by a masked killer with a personal vendetta, and as the body count rises, they must use their wits to survive.
A small-town sheriff must track down a masked killer who has returned to the town, leaving a series of grotesque crime scenes in his wake, each more horrific than the last.
An ambitious reporter investigates a series of brutal killings in a remote town, only to become the next target of the masked killer responsible for the deaths.
A group of campers in a remote forest are hunted down by a sadistic killer with a vendetta, and as they scramble for safety, they uncover a shocking connection between the killer and their group.
A masked killer stalks a group of high school students, each murder revealing disturbing clues that lead back to an unsolved mystery from years ago that ties them all together.
A group of friends reunite for a weekend getaway in a secluded mansion, but their fun quickly turns to terror when a vengeful killer begins to pick them off one by one in brutal fashion.

A blood-soaked killing spree begins when a masked figure starts targeting people in a quiet suburban neighborhood, and the locals must band together to figure out who the killer is before it’s too late.
A new tenant in an old building becomes the target of a masked killer, and as the murders pile up, she must uncover the killer’s identity before she becomes the next victim.
A masked figure begins to stalk a popular slasher film director, recreating the kills from his films in real life, and the director must confront his past and the inspiration behind his work.

A group of college students on spring break are terrorized by a masked killer, and as the bodies pile up, they must race against time to uncover the identity of the murderer before they become the next victims.

genres.name: Parody
descriptions: A team of bumbling scientists accidentally unleash a zombie apocalypse and must figure out how to stop it, using every ridiculous method imaginable in a hilarious send-up of the horror genre.
A group of washed-up superheroes must team up for one last mission, but their lack of coordination and ridiculous personalities turn every situation into a comedy of errors.
In a parody of spy thrillers, a clueless secret agent with no real skills is tasked with stopping a world-dominating villain, resulting in a hilarious series of misadventures and near-disasters.
A group of aspiring pirates with no experience at sea accidentally become legends when they mistakenly steal a treasure, but their incompetence creates a hilarious battle for riches.
In a ridiculous mockery of detective films, a bumbling investigator stumbles through a murder mystery, getting everything wrong but somehow managing to uncover the truth by sheer accident.
A parody of high-school teen movies, where an awkward student becomes the unlikely leader of a group of misfits, overcoming ridiculous challenges and cliched tropes to save the day.

In a parody of classic adventure films, a group of treasure hunters accidentally make every wrong move, leading them to comically misinterpret clues and face absurd situations on their quest for gold.
A silly parody of superhero origin stories, where a nerdy nobody accidentally gains superpowers but lacks any idea how to use them, causing more chaos than saving the day.
A parody of reality TV shows, where a group of celebrity contestants is thrown into outrageous and impossible challenges, resulting in absurd, laugh-out-loud moments and over-the-top drama.
A hilarious send-up of romance movies, where two people who can’t stand each other are forced to spend time together, only to fall in love under the most ridiculous and overused clichés.

A parody of historical epics, where a misguided emperor orders the construction of a monument, but the workers, under pressure to meet unrealistic demands, create a series of disastrous and absurd results.
In a parody of westerns, a bumbling outlaw and his equally incompetent posse accidentally become heroes, using their complete lack of skill and common sense to outwit a dangerous gang of criminals.
A comedy parody of spy films, where a young agent in over his head tries to infiltrate a villainous organization, but his awkwardness and amateur skills turn every mission into a disaster.
A parody of sports movies, where a ragtag team of misfits must come together to win a championship, despite the fact that none of them know the rules of the game or have any real talent.
A ridiculous mock-up of courtroom dramas, where a novice lawyer takes on a seemingly impossible case and, despite his bumbling incompetence, manages to win with a series of accidental victories.
A parody of fantasy epics, where a naive young hero sets out on a quest to save the world, but instead of mastering his powers, he ends up accidentally causing chaos and confusing allies.
A parody of action blockbusters, where a normal, non-athletic guy gets mistakenly recruited to save the world from a dangerous criminal, only to turn every mission into an epic disaster.

A ridiculous parody of cooking shows, where a celebrity chef must create a culinary masterpiece under pressure, but the kitchen chaos and over-the-top personalities turn the entire show into a disaster.
A parody of monster movies, where a massive creature is unleashed upon a small town, and the townspeople’s completely ridiculous and ineffective attempts to fight it only make things worse.

A parody of gangster films, where a small-time criminal with no street smarts is mistaken for a powerful mob boss, causing hilarious mayhem as he tries to navigate the dangerous world of organized crime.
A parody of fantasy adventure films, where a band of heroes, instead of fighting epic battles, face ridiculous obstacles and constantly bungle every attempt to accomplish their mission.

genres.name: Dark Comedy
descriptions: A group of funeral directors with no social skills are forced to deal with a series of bizarre and morbid deaths, leading to hilariously awkward situations and unexpected moments of humor.
A small-town hitman with a conscience is ordered to eliminate a target but becomes emotionally attached, leading to a darkly comedic spiral as he tries to juggle the murder and his growing guilt.

An ordinary man is caught in the absurdity of his own life when he becomes involved in a bizarre criminal conspiracy, leading to a series of darkly funny situations that highlight the futility of trying to escape.
A group of criminals are forced to work together during a heist gone wrong, where every attempt to escape with their loot leads to darker and more absurdly comical situations.
A funeral home worker starts to get caught up in the strange lives of the deceased, finding himself entangled in darkly humorous and bizarre situations as he tries to help the dead find peace.
An underdog character working in a corrupt corporation stumbles into a dark, hilarious plan to expose their unethical behavior, but their naive approach leads to absurd and often dangerous outcomes.

A death-obsessed artist begins to create controversial works based on the idea of mortality, but his dark and twisted sense of humor causes public outrage, leading to a series of comical misadventures.

A group of friends embark on a weekend getaway, only to discover that their friend’s sinister past is catching up with them, leading to darkly comedic scenarios where survival is just as much about humor as it is about fear.

A disgruntled family who has lost everything in a bad financial scheme takes matters into their own hands, leading to a darkly funny series of absurd decisions as they try to regain control of their lives.
A struggling actor lands a role in a snuff film but begins to question his own reality as the lines between fiction and murder blur in a hilariously twisted commentary on fame and ambition.

A disillusioned therapist becomes entangled in the messy lives of his patients, using his cynical outlook on life to navigate increasingly absurd situations while maintaining his sense of humor in the face of personal chaos.
In a quirky, dark comedy about a man obsessed with perfection, his life spirals into absurdity as every decision he makes takes him further from his goal of personal happiness and stability.
A criminal mastermind decides to retire from the business, but things take a darkly comedic turn when they inadvertently become involved in an amateur crime ring that doesn’t follow the rules.

A man’s life begins to unravel when he discovers a dead body in his garage, leading him to a darkly comedic series of events where he tries to cover up the crime, only to dig himself deeper into a hole.

A team of underachieving misfits working in a fast-food restaurant must band together to stop a series of increasingly ridiculous workplace crimes, all while maintaining a darkly humorous outlook on their doomed careers.
A family with a long history of bad luck tries to survive an ongoing series of calamities, making darkly comical decisions that only make their situation worse as they cope with their cursed fate.

A pair of ex-cops turned private detectives investigate a seemingly innocuous case, only to uncover a conspiracy that leads to darkly comical situations where their incompetence is their only saving grace.
A group of outcasts working in a mundane office job deal with the absurdities of their lives and their dark humor as they face the endless existential crisis of corporate monotony.
A cynical writer discovers that their fictional stories are coming to life, leading them to darkly comedic confrontations with the characters they’ve created, who are far less friendly than expected.
A down-on-his-luck comedian takes on the role of a villain in a low-budget crime drama, but his attempts to be menacing result in a series of darkly funny encounters with inept law enforcement.

genres.name: Coming-of-Age
descriptions: A group of high school friends struggles with growing up and finding their identity during a chaotic summer vacation, as they navigate love, loss, and the transition to adulthood.
A shy teenager embarks on a life-changing road trip with their estranged father, learning about themselves and their family’s past while gaining the courage to face the future.
A young girl in a small town must confront the painful realities of growing up when her best friend moves away, forcing her to redefine who she is and where she belongs in the world.
A group of misfit teens in a summer camp bond over shared experiences, learning about friendship, love, and loss as they face the struggles of adolescence together.
A teenager becomes torn between the expectations of their family and their desire to pursue a different career, leading to a journey of self-discovery and personal growth.
A young man grapples with his sexuality and struggles to come out to his conservative family while navigating the complexities of teenage love and acceptance.
A troubled teen is forced to spend the summer with their estranged mother, but through painful and comedic moments, they begin to rebuild their relationship and discover their own sense of identity.
A group of childhood friends reunites for a weekend getaway, and while reminiscing about the past, they discover how much they’ve grown apart and how much they’ve changed over the years.
A young girl from a strict religious family rebels against her upbringing, exploring the world beyond her community and discovering her own path to happiness and freedom.
A teenager who feels like an outsider at school is unexpectedly thrust into a leadership role, and through their awkward journey, they discover what it means to be true to themselves.
A teenage boy dealing with the death of his best friend learns how to cope with grief, growing into an adult while trying to preserve the memory of their lost friendship.
A group of high school seniors spend their last year together navigating the challenges of growing up, relationships, and the uncertainty of what the future holds after graduation.
A quiet teen develops an unexpected friendship with an eccentric new student, learning valuable life lessons about self-acceptance and the importance of letting go of the past.
A young girl from a working-class neighborhood dreams of becoming a dancer, facing challenges of class, race, and personal struggle in her pursuit of a better life.
A boy comes of age in the heart of the city, trying to navigate the complexities of family life, love, and the struggles of urban youth while striving to make a mark in the world.
A teenager forms a bond with a homeless man living on the streets, learning about resilience and the power of compassion as he navigates his own personal struggles.
A young woman must decide between staying home to care for her ailing mother or pursuing a scholarship to a prestigious college, struggling with the choice between duty and her dreams.
A teenager enters high school feeling like a nobody, but through trials of self-discovery and unexpected friendships, they begin to realize their own worth and what it means to belong.

A teen struggling with family expectations and personal insecurities finds solace in an unlikely friendship with an older mentor, learning valuable life lessons about love, loss, and finding one's voice.
A quiet, awkward high school senior finally stands up to their bullies and discovers the courage to pursue their passions, learning that sometimes you have to fight for the life you want.

genres.name: Historical Fiction
descriptions: A young soldier in World War II navigates the chaos of battle and personal conflict, finding camaraderie and discovering the true cost of war while facing a battle within himself.
In 16th-century Italy, an ambitious artist struggles to find recognition in a world dominated by powerful families, learning about love, betrayal, and the price of fame.
During the Civil Rights Movement, a young woman in the deep South becomes involved in the fight for equality, learning the harsh realities of racism while becoming a voice for change.

A group of revolutionaries in 18th-century France must navigate the political and personal dangers of their time, leading to betrayal, sacrifice, and the fight for justice during the French Revolution.
Set during the Great Depression, a small-town family faces struggles and hardships as they try to survive, leading to an exploration of love, family, and the fight for survival in a harsh world.
A woman in ancient Greece becomes a gladiator in the Colosseum, battling for survival and freedom while discovering the true meaning of strength and resilience in a male-dominated society.
A young woman in Victorian England defies societal expectations and embarks on a secret romance with a mysterious stranger, challenging the rigid norms of the time and discovering her own voice.
A struggling inventor in the early 20th century faces financial ruin, but through determination and ingenuity, they revolutionize an industry and leave a lasting legacy on the world.

During the height of the British Empire, an Indian prince navigates the complex dynamics of colonial rule, struggling to balance tradition, personal freedom, and the pressure to conform to colonial powers.
A Chinese immigrant in the 1800s works to build a new life in America, but must navigate racial prejudice, cultural identity, and the harsh realities of the American frontier.
In the midst of the American Revolution, a young soldier must make difficult choices as he navigates loyalty, duty, and the pursuit of freedom while caught between two worlds at war.
A young woman in World War I becomes a nurse on the frontlines, witnessing the horrors of war firsthand while also falling in love with a soldier who may not survive the conflict.
Set in the ancient Roman Empire, a young senator must navigate political intrigue and corruption as he tries to uphold his moral convictions, risking everything for the good of the people.

A young Jewish girl in Nazi-occupied Poland risks everything to help her family and friends survive the horrors of the Holocaust, learning about resilience and courage in the face of unimaginable evil.
During the Cold War, a young CIA recruit must choose between duty and conscience as they uncover a web of espionage, lies, and betrayal that threatens not only their career but their life.
A young writer during the Harlem Renaissance struggles with her identity, race, and ambition, finding both inspiration and heartbreak as she writes the stories of her time and generation.
A Samurai in feudal Japan must reconcile the demands of duty with his own moral beliefs as he faces a life-or-death decision that will change the course of his future and his family’s legacy.

A young woman in early 19th-century England defies her family’s expectations to pursue a life of her own, navigating love, class, and the constraints placed upon women in a society on the brink of change.

A Viking warrior faces the brutal realities of battle and leadership as he navigates political intrigue and personal ambition, struggling to define his legacy in a world dominated by war and conquest.

A renowned architect in Renaissance Florence must balance his ambitious designs with the political pressures of his time, learning about power, art, and the true cost of creation in a period of great innovation.

genres.name: Cyberpunk
descriptions: In a futuristic city dominated by mega-corporations, a rogue hacker teams up with an underground resistance to expose the dark secrets of the powerful elites, all while being pursued by lethal corporate agents.

A former corporate soldier in a dystopian world must confront his past when a heist leads him to uncover a government conspiracy, forcing him to decide between personal survival and fighting for the truth.

A brilliant but disillusioned scientist implants illegal cybernetic enhancements into their body, leading them to uncover a terrifying conspiracy involving rogue artificial intelligence and corporate greed.
A young street racer in a neon-lit city becomes involved with an underground group trying to take down the megacorporations, but their journey brings them face-to-face with their own dark secrets.
In a dystopian future, a group of hackers discovers that the government has been manipulating reality through augmented virtual spaces, and they must fight to expose the truth and liberate society.
A once-idealistic cop in a heavily surveilled society becomes a rogue vigilante after learning the truth about the sinister technologies the government is using to control the population.
In a world where humans are modified with cybernetic enhancements, a detective must track down a rogue AI that has gained consciousness and is planning to destroy the world’s digital infrastructure.
A hacker in a decaying city uncovers a mysterious message in the dark web that leads them on a dangerous journey through a fractured society controlled by ruthless corporate overlords.

In a society where human consciousness can be uploaded and transferred, a man’s mind is stolen and transferred into a robot’s body, forcing him to navigate the dark world of digital slavery and corporate manipulation.

A rogue journalist uncovers evidence of a powerful tech corporation’s plans to erase human individuality by implanting mind-controlling chips into citizens, but is hunted by the corporation’s heavily armed enforcers.

In a world of neon lights and cybernetic enhancements, a former soldier must take on a job to retrieve a valuable data chip, only to find themselves caught in a war between corporate assassins and underground rebels.

After being framed for a crime they didn’t commit, a former law enforcement officer must use their skills to survive in a world where justice is decided by the highest bidder, and corporations control everything.

A mercenary with a mysterious past must partner with a group of rogue hackers to expose the corrupt mega-corporation that runs the city’s surveillance system and control the technology that manipulates society’s reality.

A young woman with a high-tech prosthetic arm becomes a target after discovering evidence that her technology was once used to control minds, leading her to uncover a dangerous conspiracy about human enhancement.

In a bleak, neon-soaked city, a group of rebels fights to overthrow the powerful corporations that control society’s information and technology, even as the line between human and machine begins to blur.

A skilled assassin is hired to track down a rogue scientist who has invented a dangerous mind-control device, but as they get closer to their target, they begin to question the morality of their mission.

A disgraced former cop is forced to join an underground resistance after discovering that the government has been implanting surveillance chips into citizens’ bodies, leading them to uncover a world of corruption and control.

A young woman with a cybernetic implant that lets her see the world through augmented reality becomes entangled in a corporate conspiracy, discovering the truth behind the virtual world she’s been living in.

A bounty hunter in a futuristic city is tasked with bringing in a fugitive who’s been accused of hacking the digital world, but they uncover a much deeper conspiracy involving artificial intelligence and corporate espionage.

A cybernetically enhanced soldier, now living on the streets, must confront their past as they get involved with a group of rebels fighting to dismantle the global corporation that once owned their soul.

A hacker working for a mysterious benefactor must infiltrate a megacorp’s database and expose their illegal experiments, but as they get deeper into the system, they realize they may be fighting for the wrong side.

genres.name: Steampunk
descriptions: In an alternate Victorian era, a brilliant inventor creates an airship that could change the course of history, but powerful factions will stop at nothing to steal her invention and control the skies.

A young engineer in a steam-powered metropolis discovers a secret society plotting to overthrow the monarchy, and must decide whether to fight for the city’s freedom or protect the world’s fragile peace.
A disgraced airship captain teams up with a group of rebels to steal a powerful steam-powered weapon from the ruling class, sparking a revolution that will reshape the world forever.
In a world where steam technology powers everything, a young woman with a gift for invention uncovers a conspiracy involving a powerful aristocrat and must use her wits and gadgets to take them down.
A detective in a Victorian-inspired city must solve a series of mysterious disappearances linked to a corrupt inventor who is using forbidden steam-powered technology to control the city's elite.

A young noblewoman with a passion for steam engineering must disguise herself as a commoner to join a secret society dedicated to protecting the world from a corrupt government’s misuse of steam-powered machines.
A group of explorers, traveling on an advanced steam-powered vessel, must navigate dangerous uncharted waters to find a lost civilization and uncover its secrets before it falls into the wrong hands.
A master clockmaker’s latest invention leads them into a web of intrigue, where they must outwit rival inventors and corrupt officials to protect the future of steam-powered technology.
In a city powered by steam and gears, a young engineer discovers that a powerful corporation plans to monopolize all steam technology, leading to a thrilling battle for control of the city’s future.
A fearless adventurer sets out to uncover the lost city of Atlantis, powered by steam technology, while navigating treacherous seas, sky pirates, and dangerous secrets buried beneath the ocean.

A steam-powered airship captain and her crew must race against time to stop a sinister villain who plans to use a powerful steam weapon to conquer the world, with the fate of humanity hanging in the balance.

In a steam-powered empire, an inventor’s creation falls into the hands of a power-hungry aristocrat, and she must use her genius and a team of unlikely allies to stop him before he gains ultimate control.
A brilliant but eccentric inventor creates a machine capable of time travel, but when an evil organization learns of his invention, he must battle through time itself to protect the future.

In a world powered by steam engines and clockwork mechanisms, a young woman with a knack for mechanical inventions teams up with a daring thief to infiltrate a high-tech fortress and steal vital secrets.

An outlaw gang in a steam-driven world must band together to rob a train transporting a valuable cargo, but the mission becomes much more complicated when they discover the cargo holds an ancient power.

A young scientist discovers that the steam-powered technology she’s been working on can be used to manipulate reality itself, but when a secret organization learns of her discovery, they will stop at nothing to control her invention.
A steam-powered spy on a covert mission must infiltrate a high-security factory and sabotage the production of a dangerous new weapon that could alter the balance of power in a war-torn world.

A group of renegade engineers and inventors, traveling in a flying steam-powered city, must navigate through skies filled with dangerous airships, government agents, and ruthless smugglers to protect their revolutionary ideas.
In a world powered by steam and clockwork, a young mechanic uncovers a conspiracy that threatens to destroy the city, and must use her technical expertise to build a team of rebels to fight back.

A young inventor and an ex-soldier team up to stop an evil monarch from creating a weapon of mass destruction powered by steam technology, leading them into a world of espionage, sabotage, and dangerous inventions.

genres.name: Post-Apocalyptic
descriptions: After a global catastrophe wipes out most of humanity, a lone survivor embarks on a dangerous journey to find a rumored safe haven, only to face the harsh realities of a broken world.
In the aftermath of a nuclear war, a small group of survivors must navigate a desolate landscape, fighting off raiders, mutated creatures, and their own dwindling resources.
A deadly virus has wiped out civilization, and the few remaining survivors must build a new society from the ashes while battling the psychological toll of living in a decimated world.
In a world where the oceans have risen and swallowed entire cities, a group of scavengers must navigate the flooded ruins to find a legendary artifact that could restore balance to the earth.

The last remnants of humanity live in underground bunkers after a cataclysmic event, but a young engineer discovers a way to survive on the surface, igniting a dangerous quest for answers and redemption.

A small group of survivors must travel through a barren wasteland to reach a mythical city that holds the last known supply of fresh water, only to find that the greatest threat may come from within their own ranks.
After a devastating alien invasion, the surviving humans must learn to fight back and reclaim their planet, forming unlikely alliances and discovering new forms of resistance against the invaders.

A post-apocalyptic world where technology has regressed to pre-industrial levels, and a lone wanderer becomes the key to humanity’s survival after discovering the secret to reversing the environmental collapse.

A team of explorers must venture into the wasteland to recover a lost satellite that holds the key to reviving a dying planet, but they face dangers from both the mutated creatures and ruthless scavengers.

Years after a mysterious event nearly destroys the earth’s ecosystems, a scientist in a research facility above the clouds discovers a way to restore life to the surface but must make a dangerous descent to find the missing elements.

In a decimated world where the sun no longer shines, survivors must navigate a freezing, darkened landscape and fight to rebuild society using only old-world technology and the few remaining resources.

A hardened warlord and his ragtag group of survivors must protect the last known crop of food in a world where most of the earth’s vegetation has been wiped out, battling against raiders, bandits, and rival factions.

After an apocalyptic event causes global social collapse, a lone survivor discovers a hidden community that has managed to thrive in secret, but soon learns their paradise is not as perfect as it seems.

In a future where society has crumbled after a devastating asteroid impact, a group of survivors in a remote village must find a way to fend off roving gangs while uncovering the truth behind the destruction of the earth.

A woman discovers that the world she thought was destroyed after an environmental disaster is actually being controlled by an artificial intelligence, and she must decide whether to fight for humanity’s freedom or embrace a new order.

The remnants of humanity live in isolated, fortified cities after a viral outbreak has left the world in ruins, but a young woman discovers a hidden truth that could lead to the cure and a new beginning for the earth.

In a society where the rich live in domed cities while the rest of the world rots below, a young scavenger discovers a secret plan to wipe out the underclass for good and must stop it before it’s too late.

A small group of survivors living in an underground bunker are forced to venture into the dangerous world above ground after their resources run out, only to discover that what’s left of the world is far worse than they imagined.
After the fall of civilization, a mother and her child travel across a ruined landscape in search of a safe haven, while trying to hold on to the belief that a better world still exists.
The last of humanity lives in walled cities after an apocalyptic war, but a small group of rebels venture beyond the walls to find out if the outside world can be saved, or if it’s lost forever.
In a world where technology has been rendered obsolete by a cataclysmic event, a scavenger finds an ancient piece of technology that could either save humanity or bring about its final destruction.

genres.name: Survival
descriptions: After a plane crash leaves a group of strangers stranded on a remote island, they must rely on their instincts and work together to survive, but the harsh environment and each other’s secrets threaten their survival.
A group of hikers is trapped in a mountain range after an unexpected storm, and they must fight the elements and their own fears to find a way to safety.

Stranded in the wilderness with limited supplies, a skilled survivalist must guide a group of civilians through dangerous terrain to safety, facing natural obstacles and their own dwindling resources.

After a shipwreck, a lone survivor washes up on a deserted island, where they must learn to survive against the odds, battling wild animals, the elements, and isolation while trying to signal for rescue.
A small family is stranded in the harsh Arctic wilderness after their plane crashes, and must rely on each other and their survival skills to stay alive while waiting for help that may never come.
Survivors of a catastrophic earthquake find themselves trapped beneath the rubble, struggling to escape as their food and water run out, and time ticks away in the dangerous aftershocks.

A group of strangers is forced to work together after being stranded in a snowstorm, facing not only the brutal cold but also the psychological strain of being isolated and dependent on one another for survival.

After a global blackout, a family must adapt to life without electricity, fighting for food and water in a world that has descended into chaos, learning that the true fight for survival is much more than just the physical elements.

A lone soldier is stranded in enemy territory and must use his training and survival instincts to survive and escape, navigating through hostile terrain and evading enemy forces while trying to reach friendly lines.

Trapped in a sinking ship in the middle of the ocean, a group of passengers must navigate the dangers of the sea and each other in their desperate fight for survival before the ship goes down completely.
After a plane crashes in the middle of a dense jungle, the survivors must navigate their way through dangerous wildlife and hostile terrain while struggling to stay alive and find a way out.
A young woman is left behind in a post-apocalyptic wasteland and must learn to survive on her own, battling both the environment and ruthless bandits as she journeys to find safety.

After a shipwreck leaves a group of survivors stranded on a deserted island, they must navigate the deadly dangers of the island and learn to coexist with each other while searching for a way to escape.

A couple trapped in a remote cabin during a snowstorm must work together to survive, facing physical exhaustion, dwindling supplies, and the emotional strain of being isolated in a life-or-death situation.

A young man must survive in the wild after a plane crash leaves him alone in the wilderness, using his wit and survival training to outsmart predators and overcome natural disasters while struggling to find food and shelter.

A group of astronauts is stranded on Mars after a mission goes wrong, and they must use their limited resources to survive until a rescue mission can be mounted, facing both the harsh environment and their isolation from Earth.

A lone survivor of a natural disaster must trek through a devastated city to reach the last known safe zone, navigating crumbling buildings and avoiding other survivors who have become more dangerous than the environment itself.
After an economic collapse leaves society in ruins, a former soldier must protect a small group of survivors as they navigate the harsh, post-apocalyptic world and search for a place to rebuild.
Stranded in the wilderness with no supplies, a family must fight to stay alive and keep hope alive as they confront the brutal realities of the environment and their own survival instincts.

A group of survivors must work together to stay alive in the aftermath of a devastating solar flare, navigating the wreckage of their society while struggling to find food, water, and shelter in a world without electricity.

genres.name: Fantasy Comedy
descriptions: A group of bumbling wizards must team up to find a lost magical artifact, but their clumsy spells and misadventures threaten to destroy the world instead of saving it.
When a mortal stumbles into a hidden magical realm, they must help a quirky band of fairies, elves, and talking animals stop a villainous sorcerer from turning the world into a never-ending party.
A witch accidentally curses a prince to turn into a frog every time he sneezes, and she must work with a hilarious group of magical creatures to break the spell before the kingdom falls into chaos.

In a land where magic is common, a lowly shopkeeper becomes an unlikely hero after accidentally stealing a powerful magical gem, and now he must learn how to use it before it falls into the wrong hands.
After a failed magic spell, a group of adventurers find themselves turned into animals, and they must rely on their wits and teamwork to break the curse and save their enchanted kingdom.
A charming but lazy dragon who just wants to retire must team up with a bumbling wizard to stop an ancient prophecy from destroying the world, all while trying to avoid any real work.

A wizard and his bumbling apprentice are tasked with saving the kingdom, but they must navigate a series of ridiculous trials, including an enchanted potato that turns anyone who touches it into a dancing fool.
A prince who can only speak in rhymes is forced to find a cure to his strange curse before his royal wedding, aided by a motley crew of magical creatures who all have their own peculiar problems.

A hapless hero with absolutely no magical skills is accidentally chosen to defeat an evil sorcerer, leading to a series of comedic encounters with knights, dragons, and an overly dramatic talking sword.
A group of fairies gets sent to the mortal realm to grant wishes, but their lack of understanding about human behavior leads to a series of chaotic and hilarious misadventures.

After a magical mishap, a group of villagers swap bodies with animals, and they must find a way to switch back before their village is taken over by an evil warlord, all while trying to communicate with their new animal forms.

A wizard who has forgotten how to cast spells must travel across the kingdom to find a legendary magical artifact that will restore his powers, with the help of his reluctant and sarcastic talking cat.

When a group of adventurers accidentally summon a mischievous imp, they must outwit it and undo the chaos it causes, leading to a series of hilarious escapades through enchanted forests and haunted castles.
In a world where everyone has magical abilities, a non-magical man must join a group of eccentric wizards and witches to stop an ancient curse from unleashing total chaos on the realm.

A hero who is destined to save the world with a magical sword finds out the sword is completely useless, forcing him to team up with a clumsy wizard and a sarcastic talking bird to find a new way to defeat evil.
A group of magical creatures forms a mismatched team to stop a dark sorcerer from unleashing an ancient evil, but their hilarious personalities and antics might just save the day in unexpected ways.

When a simple farmer discovers he’s the long-lost heir to a magical throne, he must learn to use his new powers, navigate a palace full of eccentric courtiers, and avoid an evil warlock who wants to take the throne for himself.

A bumbling knight, an exasperated wizard, and a sarcastic dragon are sent on a quest to retrieve a powerful relic, but their constant bickering and comical incompetence may just be the key to success.

A clumsy wizard accidentally turns a village into giant mushrooms, and now he must work with a ragtag group of magical misfits to undo the spell before the entire kingdom turns into a forest of fungus.

In a kingdom where magic and technology clash, a brilliant inventor and a hopeless wizard must team up to stop a tyrannical sorcerer from using magic-powered machines to rule the world, all while causing endless chaos with their mismatched skills.
A magical creature who’s been cursed to live as a human must navigate the complexities of mortal life, falling into a series of humorous situations while trying to figure out how to break the curse.

genres.name: Teen
descriptions: A group of high school friends starts an underground club to survive their senior year, but things get out of hand when they accidentally become the center of a school-wide conspiracy.
A socially awkward teenager accidentally gets cast as the lead in the school play and must navigate the pressures of fame, friendship, and falling in love, all while trying to avoid a total meltdown.
When a shy teen inherits an old family mansion, they must team up with their misfit friends to solve the mystery of the house’s haunted history before it’s too late.

A group of teens in a small town discover a secret underground bunker filled with strange technology, and they must figure out how to use it before their lives are turned upside down by mysterious forces.
An unpopular high schooler gets a magical ability that lets them read minds, but the power quickly becomes a curse as they learn too many embarrassing truths about their classmates and themselves.
A teen with big dreams of escaping their small town accidentally becomes the star of a viral video, leading to unexpected fame, new friendships, and a series of hilarious misadventures.
A rebellious teenager who hates everything about high school becomes the target of an unexpected time-traveling conspiracy, and must team up with their nerdy classmates to save the future.
When a group of friends accidentally discover an old time machine, they must navigate high school while trying to keep their time-hopping antics a secret from everyone around them.

A shy teenager with a passion for theater must find the courage to audition for the school play, only to discover that the drama of high school is far more intense than anything they’ve seen on stage.

A group of outcast teens discovers they have supernatural powers, and must balance their school lives with their newfound abilities while trying to protect the world from a secret organization that wants to control them.
A teenager who can’t seem to fit in accidentally gets cast as the school’s mascot, and must use their newfound position of power to navigate school politics and help save their failing school.

A high school science nerd builds a robot as a science project, but when the robot comes to life, the teenager must figure out how to stop it from taking over the school while keeping it a secret from their parents.
A teenager is forced to spend the summer with their eccentric grandmother in a tiny town, only to discover that their grandmother’s odd stories about magical creatures might just be true.
A high school football player who’s never been great at anything else must learn to master a new sport—dodgeball—when their school’s team becomes a battleground for school spirit and teen rivalry.
After a mix-up with a school play prop, a group of teens accidentally summon a demon, and they must work together to banish it before their lives are completely turned upside down.

A teenager discovers their parents are superheroes, and they must juggle high school drama with the challenges of being the child of legendary crime-fighters in a world that expects them to be extraordinary.
A quiet, misunderstood teen finds a magical journal that lets them write their own destiny, but they quickly learn that changing the future comes with dangerous and hilarious consequences.
When an overachieving teen is forced to spend the summer working at a beach resort, they accidentally uncover a treasure map, leading them on a hilarious adventure filled with rival treasure hunters.

A group of teens trying to win the ultimate high school talent show must overcome their insecurities and learn to work together, all while facing the pressures of being teenagers in a competitive environment.

A group of high school friends accidentally get trapped in a simulation of their own school life and must work together to solve puzzles and unlock the truth behind the digital world before they’re stuck forever.

genres.name: Heist
descriptions: A master thief assembles a team of skilled criminals to pull off the ultimate heist: stealing a priceless artifact from a high-security museum, but their plans unravel when one member goes rogue.
A group of career criminals attempts to rob a high-end casino, but the heist quickly spirals into chaos when they realize they’ve underestimated the security system—and each other.
When a small-time con artist gets involved in a large-scale bank robbery, they must prove their worth to the mastermind while dealing with their growing distrust of the crew’s true motives.
A team of thieves plans a daring heist on a billionaire’s mansion, but the job gets complicated when they uncover a dark family secret that threatens to change everything.

A group of thieves, each with their own special skill, must work together to steal a fortune in diamonds hidden beneath a heavily guarded mansion, but things take a turn when they discover the diamonds are cursed.
A former thief is pulled back into the world of crime when an old associate convinces him to pull off one last job—a heist on a military convoy carrying a priceless weapon.
An expert hacker is brought into a heist to steal a valuable database, but the heist becomes a race against time when they uncover a government conspiracy that could ruin their lives.
A team of criminals plans to steal a rare piece of art, but their perfect plan unravels when they discover the painting is a fake, and they must find a way to fix their mistake before it’s too late.

A group of ex-convicts decides to rob a casino in the middle of a high-stakes poker tournament, but when things go wrong, they must outsmart the casino’s security and a determined FBI agent on their tail.

An elite team of thieves must break into an impenetrable vault to steal millions, but one of them has a secret agenda, forcing the team to question who they can trust and who is willing to betray them.
A team of hackers and thieves must plan and execute the heist of a lifetime: breaking into the most secure government facility in the country, all while staying one step ahead of the law.

A group of disgruntled employees at a tech company decide to steal the company’s most valuable intellectual property, but as the heist progresses, they realize their corporate greed has unforeseen consequences.

When a group of criminals steals a rare artifact from a wealthy collector, they find themselves being hunted by a group of mercenaries hired to retrieve it, leading to a high-octane chase across the globe.
A team of thieves stages an elaborate heist to steal gold from an armored truck, but things go awry when they discover the gold is counterfeit and must scramble to cover up their mistake.

A former thief is forced back into the game when his daughter is kidnapped, and the only way to save her is by stealing a valuable artifact from a corrupt billionaire with ties to dangerous criminals.

An expert pickpocket gets caught up in a heist to steal a priceless diamond, but the job takes an unexpected turn when a love interest is thrown into the mix, complicating the heist and their relationship.

A crew of professional thieves is tasked with stealing an ancient artifact, but their plans are thrown into disarray when they discover that the artifact may have mystical powers that could alter the course of history.

A group of thieves planning a robbery on a wealthy mansion find themselves in over their heads when they learn the house is rigged with state-of-the-art security systems and booby traps that could kill them at any moment.

A criminal mastermind assembles a team to steal a rare painting, but as they approach the heist, the team begins to question their loyalty and motivations, leading to a thrilling, unpredictable conclusion.

A high-stakes heist to rob a casino owned by a notorious crime boss goes awry when one of the crew members falls in love with the boss’s daughter, complicating everything and raising the stakes for everyone involved.

A group of thieves who specialize in stealing luxury cars come up with an elaborate plan to steal the most expensive sports car ever made, but their plan is threatened when an inside informant betrays them.

genres.name: Disaster
descriptions: A group of survivors must navigate a city devastated by a series of natural disasters, including earthquakes, tsunamis, and fires, while trying to reunite with their families and escape the chaos.
After a massive earthquake hits a coastal city, a rescue team must race against time to save trapped survivors while dealing with aftershocks, flooding, and the growing threat of a deadly tsunami.

A sudden, unexpected volcanic eruption plunges the city into chaos, and a group of strangers must work together to escape the ash-filled streets while battling not only nature but also their own fears and insecurities.

A group of scientists must find a way to stop a supervolcano from erupting before it destroys the entire planet, but their efforts are complicated by a government conspiracy and the unraveling of their own relationships.
When an asteroid threatens to collide with Earth, a group of astronauts must work together to stop it, facing spacewalks, malfunctions, and their own personal conflicts along the way.

In the aftermath of a global blackout, a small community must band together to survive, finding themselves at the mercy of a collapsing infrastructure and the deadly consequences of modern society’s reliance on technology.
A massive wildfire threatens a small town, and a group of firefighters must battle the inferno while dealing with their personal struggles and the reality of what it takes to survive the blaze.
After a deadly tsunami devastates a coastal town, survivors must navigate a world filled with destroyed infrastructure and dangerous wildlife, all while searching for fresh water and shelter.

In the wake of a nuclear disaster, a group of people trapped in a fallout shelter must figure out how to survive in the radioactive wasteland outside, facing shortages of food, water, and medical supplies.

A powerful earthquake shakes the city, and the survivors must work together to find their loved ones, while also trying to navigate through crumbling buildings, gas leaks, and an ever-growing sense of desperation.

A group of adventurers in a remote mountain range must survive after a plane crash leaves them stranded in freezing temperatures, battling the elements and their own limited resources in an unforgiving environment.
After an oil rig explosion causes an environmental catastrophe, a team of engineers must race against time to stop the leak and save the world from an impending ecological disaster.

A once-thriving city is reduced to rubble after a catastrophic flood, and a group of survivors must make their way through the wreckage, battling rising waters, dangerous criminals, and the overwhelming sense of hopelessness.
In the aftermath of a widespread pandemic, the survivors must navigate an apocalyptic world, dealing with the chaos of collapsed governments, resource scarcity, and the unrelenting fear of illness.
A massive tornado rips through a small town, and a group of survivors must band together to find safety, all while navigating the storm’s aftermath and the terrifying consequences of nature’s fury.

A deadly heatwave sweeps across the globe, and a group of scientists must race to find a solution before the earth’s temperatures reach catastrophic levels, all while battling political intrigue and limited resources.
A volcanic eruption threatens a coastal city, and a group of ordinary citizens must become unlikely heroes in the race to escape before the lava and ash bury everything in their path.

A devastating snowstorm traps a group of travelers in a remote lodge, and they must survive together against not only the freezing temperatures but also the growing tension and distrust among the group.

After a massive power outage, a city is plunged into chaos, and a group of residents must work together to restore order, even as dangerous gangs take control of the streets and basic supplies become scarce.

As a dangerous comet hurtles toward Earth, a group of survivors must race to a government facility to unlock a secret plan for saving humanity, all while fighting off government agents who are determined to stop them.
